    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg = c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(grid) for j, x in enumerate(r) if x != bg]
    rs = [p[0] for p in pts]; cs = [p[1] for p in pts]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    o = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # fill bounding-box border with 2 where background
    for j in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        for i in (r0, r1):
            if o[i][j] == bg: o[i][j] = 2
    for i in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for j in (c0, c1):
            if o[i][j] == bg: o[i][j] = 2
    # complete broken interior straight lines of marks
    for j in range(c0 + 1, c1):
        col = [i for i in range(r0 + 1, r1) if grid[i][j] != bg]

    for i in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        row = [j for j in range(c0 + 1, c1) if grid[i][j] != bg]
        for a, b in zip(row, row[1:]):
            for j in range(a + 1, b):
                if o[i][j] == bg: o[i][j] = 2
    return o
